name: URY desk order form
describe: URY Order form on the Order tab: Add Item, Grand Total (read only), Additional Details, the Items field-table (URY Order Item: Item, Item Name, Qty, Rate, Comments) and the Waiter / POS Profile / Cashier read-only links.
The URY Printer Settings child table is a field of URY Production Unit (not of URY Order), so it is drawn in the production-unit variant.
